clips.purpose: Run gait / combat follow, left lead 3-beat
Engaged ridden movement, canter head low
Walking left turn, 30 deg per cycle
Walking right turn, 30 deg per cycle
Cantering left turn, 25 deg per cycle
Cantering right turn, 25 deg per cycle
Pivot 90 deg left on the spot
Pivot 90 deg right on the spot
Pivot 180 deg left on the spot
Pivot 180 deg right on the spot
Double hind-hoof kick at a target behind
Injured but standing, resting a hind leg
Holding still at the station, alert
Signature B owner movement aid: rear and call
Idle break: head shake and stamp

limitations: Procedural key-pose/gait animation, not captured or hand-animated motion; needs animator review for production feel.
Actions are FK pose keys for the primary rig; root motion is recorded separately per clip and is not in bones.
Hair, tack and feathering follow primary weights rigidly; secondary motion is a separate stage.
Surface strain and contact are measured diagnostics, not visual approval.
